title: Stress in Thick-Walled Cylinders or Tubes
description: Calculate stress in thick-walled cylinders or tubes subjected to internal and external pressure. Computes axial, circumferential (hoop), and radial stress at any point in the tube wall.

components.content: Enter the cylinder or tube parameters to calculate stresses in different directions.

outputs.label: Axial Stress (σa)
outputs.formula: (inputs.pi * inputs.ri * inputs.ri - inputs.po * inputs.ro * inputs.ro) / (inputs.ro * inputs.ro - inputs.ri * inputs.ri)

outputs.label: Circumferential/Hoop Stress (σc)
outputs.formula: ((inputs.pi * inputs.ri * inputs.ri - inputs.po * inputs.ro * inputs.ro) / (inputs.ro * inputs.ro - inputs.ri * inputs.ri)) + ((inputs.ri * inputs.ri * inputs.ro * inputs.ro * (inputs.pi - inputs.po)) / (inputs.r * inputs.r * (inputs.ro * inputs.ro - inputs.ri * inputs.ri)))

outputs.label: Radial Stress (σr)
outputs.formula: ((inputs.pi * inputs.ri * inputs.ri - inputs.po * inputs.ro * inputs.ro) / (inputs.ro * inputs.ro - inputs.ri * inputs.ri)) - ((inputs.ri * inputs.ri * inputs.ro * inputs.ro * (inputs.pi - inputs.po)) / (inputs.r * inputs.r * (inputs.ro * inputs.ro - inputs.ri * inputs.ri)))

rows: (inputs.pi * inputs.ri * inputs.ri - inputs.po * inputs.ro * inputs.ro) / (inputs.ro * inputs.ro - inputs.ri * inputs.ri)

At radius r (maximum at r = ri)
